notes.zh-CN: 手机和电脑之间的消息不再经过飞书群，飞书只用来验证登录。会话、在线状态和定时任务都走自托管同步服务；旧连接码仍可导入，群 ID 与机器人 ID 会被忽略。使用手机定时任务需要把同步服务更新到本版本，未更新时仍可浏览和续聊。macOS 为 universal 开发签名、未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 为 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队已注册设备，均非商店包。
notes.en: Phone and computer no longer exchange messages through a Feishu group. Feishu only verifies sign-in. Sessions, presence, and scheduled tasks go through the self-hosted sync service. Older pairing codes still import; their group and bot ids are ignored. Scheduled tasks on the phone need the sync service updated to this version; browsing and continuing chats still work before that update. macOS is universal and development-signed, not notarized; Windows installers are unsigned; APK is debug-signed; IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only. These are not store builds.
